verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's TruLease product is explicitly marketed for meeting compliance requirements for 'financial accounts, Amazon Store, and more' (docs-7, docs-14), and the Address Overview page (docs-15) says it helps founders pick between mailbox, TruLease, or TruResidence addresses for their business needs, implying guidance on address suitability. However, there is no explicit statement spelling out which address type banks/payment processors will or won't accept, nor documentation of specific processors' acceptance policies. Missing for 10: explicit vendor guidance naming which address type fails bank/KYC checks, sample bank-accepted proof-of-address documents, and independent confirmation from banks/processors of acceptance.
